name: Espresso
description: A bold, concentrated shot of pure coffee goodness. Rich crema on top with an intense, full-bodied flavor.

name: Cappuccino
description: Equal parts espresso, steamed milk, and velvety foam. A classic Italian favorite topped with a dusting of cocoa.

name: Caramel Latte
description: Smooth espresso blended with steamed milk and sweet caramel syrup, finished with a drizzle of caramel.

name: Americano
description: Espresso diluted with hot water for a smooth, rich cup. All the flavor with a lighter body.

name: Cold Brew
description: Steeped for 18 hours, our cold brew is ultra-smooth with low acidity and a naturally sweet finish.

name: Iced Mocha
description: Rich chocolate sauce, espresso, and cold milk poured over ice. Topped with whipped cream.

name: Matcha Latte
description: Premium ceremonial-grade matcha whisked with steamed oat milk. Earthy, smooth, and energizing.

name: Lavender Honey Latte
description: Calming lavender syrup and local honey blended with espresso and steamed milk. Floral and soothing.
